svg.title: How an update of the blueprint arrives
svg.desc: Right after every release of the blueprint, and every week, the blueprint bot verifies the latest published release first. A release that is not immutable, whose tag is not on the main branch of the blueprint or that the release workflow of the blueprint didn't sign fails the run, and nothing is updated. Otherwise the bot runs copier update to that release. When its pull request is still open and you have committed to its branch, the bot leaves the branch to you and says once that a newer release is out. Otherwise it opens the pull request, or moves the open one on to the new release. With conflicts, which turn auto-merge off, or with BLUEPRINT_AUTOMERGE set to off, it waits for the maintainer; otherwise it merges itself once every check passes.
